_meta.name: hound-dock design tokens
_meta.scope: Minimal token set for the effective desktop pages PG-001 to PG-012 and components C-01 to C-17. Light theme only; 960px is the narrowest adopted width.
_meta.valueBasis: Colour values are copied from the light column of design_system.md §3.1 and the matching :root primitives in prototype/styles.css. Type, spacing, radius, shadow, and layout values are the recorded candidates in design_system.md §3.2 to §3.4 and the 1440/1280/1080/960 measures in highfi_page_map.md §7 and interaction_design.md §7. Every colour is a candidate, not a brand value.
_meta.layerRule: primitive -> semantic -> component. Component tokens reference semantic or component tokens for colour, spacing, radius, and elevation; documented component dimensions are defined once in the component layer.

TBD-INFRA-001.effect: Frontend stack and component library are unselected. Every frontend field is [TBD-FE]; no component library is assumed.

TBD-BIZ-004.statusAsRecorded: Resolved in open_items.md (CHG-012; admin-only skill and task publication)
TBD-BIZ-004.effect: Referenced as-is for the read-only and terminal-Empty component behaviour. It is not re-decided, rewritten, or used to add a control.

_meta.conflicts: No CONFLICT is cited or adjudicated. CONFLICT-001 and CONFLICT-002 do not determine a token value.
_meta.theme: light-only; the dark reference column in design_system.md §3.1 and §6 is excluded.
_meta.contrast: design_system.md §6 records the light contrast pairs. This file cites them as candidate evidence and performs no new measurement; the neutral status pair is not recorded in §6.
_meta.spacingScale: The 4px to 80px ramp is the recorded candidate scale. Component references cover the steps used by the effective key-page components; the remaining steps are scale values, not reserved control tokens.
_meta.componentCoverage: Component tokens are defined only where design_system.md records a stable knob. C-04 (recorded count), C-15 (live region), and C-17 (back link) are composed from semantic tokens and have no separate component-layer entry. C-01 to C-17 are the only permitted component names.
trimmed: Dark theme mapping (design_system.md §3.1 and §6): reference-only, not a theme decision.
shadow-md: used only by the skip link, not by a key-page surface.
text-3xl 28px: reserved compact display title; no effective page uses it.
control-h-lg 42px: reserved large control; no effective page uses it.
content-max 1360px: binds only above the adopted 1440px baseline.
Motion durations and easing: outside this token contract.
Ad-hoc prototype literals such as 9px, 10px, 14px, and 30px: not promoted to tokens.
notClaimed: Not a brand palette, not a Frozen design system, and not a production implementation contract.
Not a frontend stack, component-library choice, or handoff format.
Not a dark theme, mobile layout, or any layout below 960px.
Not an approval of Gate 1 or of any page construction.
